title: Responsive Breakpoint Cascade Precedence & Override Reset Restoration

requirement.summary: Merchants can configure device-specific overrides (mobile, tablet) for theme sections, and resetting an override deterministically restores cascade inheritance without corrupting other device values or leaking state across page reloads.
requirement.user_outcome: Theme customizations display correctly on every device; clearing a mobile override instantly and safely reverts to the tablet override (or desktop baseline) without lost data.
preconditions: Theme section AST document initialized with baseline properties
Supported device viewports: mobile (320px-430px), tablet (768px-1024px), desktop (1280px-1440px)

protected_behaviour: Mobile override is authoritative when defined: resolveResponsive(desk, Some(tab), Some(mob)) === mob
Tablet override is fallback when mobile is None: resolveResponsive(desk, Some(tab), None) === tab
Desktop baseline is default when both are None: resolveResponsive(desk, None, None) === desk
Resetting an override on mobile deterministically restores resolution to the parent tablet override
Clearing an override on one device leaves all other device values unchanged (layer isolation)
Saving and reloading theme AST preserves every explicitly configured device override without loss
forbidden_behaviour: Resetting an override clears or corrupts unrelated device breakpoints
Reloading the editor loses mobile-specific overrides
Selecting preview presets mutates underlying theme AST values
Horizontal viewport overflow (scrollWidth > innerWidth) on any supported device

executable_model.correspondence_bridge: src/lib/responsive.ts (resolveResponsiveProp, cleanEmptyBreakpoints) synchronized via SHA-256 drift gate

adversarial_checks.mutation_description: Mutate desktop baseline during mobile override reset
Reverse precedence cascade so desktop takes priority over mobile
